Critical colour never tweens. The retained fill uses a four-phase pulse and returns exactly to full opacity each second.

Vertical Steps / the same motion grammar
Orientation changes geometry, not semantics: bottom-up steps retain the same exact head, state and bounded settle contract.

Micro / Expressive automatically reduces to Refined
